service_enabled.description: Whether the ancient service is enabled (maps to 'enabled=yes' or 'enabled=no')

modes.description: List of operation modes to run (valid values: identify, verify, decompress, scan)

input_files.description: List of input files to process (required for identify, verify, decompress modes)

output_file.description: Output file path (required for decompress mode; optional for verify mode)

input_dir.description: Input directory to scan (required for scan mode)

output_dir.description: Output directory for decompressed files (required for scan mode)

log_file.description: Path to log file for verbose output

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each operation (e.g., decompression or scanning)
